channel.title: SnowScope · Snow reports
channel.description: Daily snow reports for skiers: where the snow is, what is coming and where to ski, from the SnowScope snow map and measuring stations. Every number comes from that day's data.

item.title: Red Lodge Mountain snow: 14 in (36 cm) up top and 5 in (13 cm) coming Saturday, but the base is far behind
item.description: Red Lodge Mountain in Montana's Beartooths: snow today, the weekend storm, how far behind a normal year it is, and what December usually brings.

item.title: Reiteralm snow: 22 cm up top, ahead of a normal late November in the Schladming-Dachstein area
item.description: Reiteralm near Schladming has its early snow. Today's depth, what a usual December and Christmas bring, and how this quiet family area fits into Ski amadé.

item.title: Vogel above Lake Bohinj has 50 cm of snow, many times a normal late November
item.description: Slovenia's Vogel ski area got a big storm this week. Today's snow, why the Julian Alps catch these storms, and what usually happens next in December.

item.title: Lake Tahoe for Christmas 2026: three to four times the usual late-November snow, Kirkwood leads with 33 in (84 cm)
item.description: Tahoe's resorts are far ahead of a normal year after the mid-November storms. Christmas odds for Kirkwood, Sugar Bowl, Palisades, Heavenly and Northstar.

item.title: Tamarack Resort this weekend: a little snow Saturday, then 6 in (16 cm) on Monday
item.description: Tamarack in Idaho's West Mountains: today's snow, the weekend day by day, the Monday storm, and how this start compares with a normal year.

item.title: Mammoth Mountain in December 2026: right on a normal year, and the week-by-week snow you can expect
item.description: Mammoth has 19 in (48 cm) on its upper slopes and sits close to a normal late-November base. What each December week usually brings, from 46 winters.

item.title: Manning Park at Christmas 2026: after 17 in (43 cm) this week, a 50 cm base by New Year has come every winter
item.description: Manning Park Resort between Hope and Princeton just got a storm. Today's snow, the Christmas odds from 46 winters, and planning a holiday trip from Vancouver.

item.title: Apex Mountain snow report: 15 in (38 cm) up top and cold, dry snow near Penticton
item.description: Apex Mountain Resort in the Okanagan: snow today, the days ahead, how it compares with a normal late November, and what December and Christmas usually look like.

item.title: December 2026 in Colorado: Vail and Breckenridge start far behind, Aspen Snowmass leads with 29 in (73 cm)
item.description: Colorado's big resorts go into December with a thin base. How far behind each one is, what a normal December adds, and where to go first.

item.title: Chamonix at Christmas 2026: the high areas already have more than a normal 25 December
item.description: Snow depth in Chamonix on 27 November, Christmas odds from 46 winters at the Grands Montets and Brévent, and why the valley floor is a different story.

item.title: Mount Timothy snow: 7 in (17 cm) on the hill, well short of a normal late November in the Cariboo
item.description: Mount Timothy near 100 Mile House: today's snow, the forecast, how far behind a normal year it is, and what December usually brings to this Cariboo community hill.

item.title: Telluride right now: 4.4 ft (133 cm) up top, the deepest start in Colorado. What it means for Christmas
item.description: Telluride's upper slopes hold the most snow of any big Colorado resort today. Christmas odds from 46 winters, and where the snow is best.

item.title: Big White at Christmas 2026: a 50 cm base by New Year in 98% of winters, and 41 in (103 cm) up top today
item.description: Big White near Kelowna is one of the most reliable Christmas resorts in Canada. Today's snow, the usual December 25, and planning the family week.

item.title: Jackson Hole for New Year 2027: behind today, but a 50 cm base by Jan. 1 in every one of 46 winters
item.description: Jackson Hole has 18 in (45 cm) up top and 9 in (23 cm) on the way Saturday. What New Year's week usually looks like, and how to plan it.

item.title: Val Thorens snow depth: 146 cm up top in late November, more than twice a normal year at mid-mountain
item.description: Europe's highest ski resort starts December deep. How rare this is in 46 winters, what it means for December and Christmas, and where the best snow is.

item.title: Where to ski near Calgary in December 2026: every area is below normal, Sunshine and Castle hold the most
item.description: Banff Sunshine, Lake Louise, Norquay, Nakiska and Castle Mountain compared for a December day trip from Calgary: snow today, how far behind normal, and what December usually adds.

item.title: Snow in Utah's Wasatch this weekend: a light refresh, and Brighton holds the most at 33 in (84 cm)
item.description: Little and Big Cottonwood canyons and Park City for Saturday 28 and Sunday 29 November: today's snow, the weekend top-up, and how this start compares with a normal year.

item.title: Saddleback in December 2026: thin natural snow today, and what a Rangeley December usually brings
item.description: Saddleback Mountain near Rangeley, Maine: snow today, the coming days, and what 46 winters say about December and Christmas on one of New England's highest ski mountains.

item.title: Marmot Basin snow report: 14 in (35 cm) up top, far below a normal late November in Jasper
item.description: Marmot Basin's snow today, the next days, and why this start is unusual for one of Canada's most reliable early-season mountains.

item.title: Skiing near Portland in December 2026: Timberline has 33 in (83 cm), Skibowl has none
item.description: Mt. Hood shows how much a few hundred feet matter: today's snow at Timberline, Meadows, Skibowl and Mt. Bachelor, the next three days, and what December usually brings.

item.title: Tignes snow odds for New Year 2027: a 50 cm base by 1 January in 98% of winters, and almost twice the usual snow today
item.description: Tignes and the Espace Killy go into December far ahead of a normal year. What New Year's week usually looks like at 2,500 m, and how to plan it.

item.title: China ski resorts snow forecast, 28 November - 4 December: snow for the Altay, a dry week for Chongli
item.description: Koktokay could get about 13 cm, Hemu and Jiangjunshan about 8 cm by 4 December; Chongli, Yanqing and the Jilin resorts stay dry.

item.title: Vermont ski weekend: the first natural snow reaches Stowe and Smugglers' Notch, about 6 in (16 cm) by Monday
item.description: Northern Vermont gets its first real snow of the season over the Thanksgiving weekend. Resort by resort, north to south, and what is normal for early December.

item.title: Will Whistler have snow for Christmas 2026? Up top it already has 8.7 ft (266 cm)
item.description: Whistler Blackcomb's upper slopes hold 8.7 ft (266 cm) after a 4.6 ft (141 cm) three-day storm. What 46 winters say about Christmas, and why the valley is the only question.

item.title: Snow in China's ski areas today: Altay leads, Chongli waits for natural snow (27 November)
item.description: 45 of 130 ski areas in northern China have natural snow today. Hemu has 70 cm, Koktokay 40 cm; around Chongli the natural snow is still under 10 cm.

item.title: Where to ski near Seattle in December 2026: the Cascades just got 25 in (64 cm), pass by pass
item.description: Crystal, Stevens, Snoqualmie, Mt. Baker and White Pass after this week's storm: today's snow, the next three days, and what a normal December brings to each pass.

item.title: Hokkaido snow report, 27 November 2026: Kiroro has a metre, Niseko and Rusutsu are still thin
item.description: Snow on the upper slopes today: Kiroro 119 cm, Sapporo Kokusai 103 cm, Asahidake 61 cm, Niseko 31 cm, Furano 29 cm, Rusutsu 16 cm, and only light snow in the next 8 days.

item.title: Japan Alps snowstorm this weekend: rain first, then about 60 cm for Hakuba, Tsugaike and Myoko (28-30 November 2026)
item.description: A storm crosses central Japan on 28 and 29 November: rain on Saturday, then snow. Hakuba Happo-one gets about 62 cm on the upper slopes, Tsugaike 61 cm, Myoko Suginohara 57 cm.

item.title: Mount baker ski snow report: powder arrives as November peaks
item.description: Mt Baker received 40 cm of fresh snow on 26 Nov. Three resorts across the US West got major dumps; more snow forecast through the weekend.

item.title: Spanish ski resorts running 2.5 times ahead of normal for late November
item.description: Candanchu holds 35 cm, well above its usual 14 cm for this date. Fresh snow across Spain's mountains is boosting early-season conditions on 25 November.

item.title: Mediterranean mountains snow outlook for December 2026, January and February 2027, range by range
item.description: A seasonal snow outlook for 18 Mediterranean ranges, from the Atlas to Erciyes, built from the ECMWF and Météo-France seasonal forecasts (51 members each). Every range is 1.1 to 2.7 °C warmer than the 1991-2020 normal, precipitation stays near normal, but snowfall is below normal on 16 of the 18 ranges: High Atlas -48 %, Apennines -28 %, Pyrenees -24 %, Alps near normal.

item.title: Andes snow outlook to mid-December: spring melt wins, 12 % chance of a normal fortnight (ECMWF, NOAA, NASA, 24 November 2026)
item.description: Snow outlook for the central and Patagonian Andes from 24 November to 14 December 2026, from the 50-member ECMWF ensemble, NOAA GEFS and NASA MODIS: snow line on the ground near 3,000 m, Portillo 40 % above normal, Bariloche and Chapelco almost nothing.

item.title: Pyrenees snow outlook to mid-December: Formigal 94 %, Andorra 12 % chance of an above-normal fortnight (24 November 2026)
item.description: Pyrenees snow forecast for the next 3 weeks from the 50-member ECMWF ensemble, NOAA GEFS and NASA MODIS: a near-normal fortnight overall (19.1 cm against 18.3 cm), snowy in the west and centre, lean towards Andorra and Cerdanya. Snow line on the ground about 1,500 m.

item.title: US and Canada snow outlook to mid-December: 88 % chance of an above-normal fortnight in the West (ECMWF, NOAA, NASA, 24 November 2026)
item.description: Western US and Canada snow forecast for the next 3 weeks from the 50-member ECMWF ensemble, NOAA GEFS and NASA MODIS: Whistler median 82 in (210 cm) by 8 December, Mammoth 21 in (53 cm), Alta 14 in (35 cm), Vail 14 in (34 cm). Lake Louise is the lean spot at 12 %.

item.title: Mt. Hood Meadows snow forecast: Mt. Hood Meadows sees half the usual snow by late November
item.description: Mt. Hood Meadows has 51 cm on upper slopes, well below the 73 cm average. Up to 66 cm new snow forecast by November 27 at Crystal Mountain.

item.title: Alps snow outlook to mid-December: a snowy week, then a dry spell (10 % chance of a normal fortnight, 24 November 2026)
item.description: Alps snow forecast for the next 3 weeks from the 50-member ECMWF ensemble, NOAA GEFS and NASA MODIS: 19.1 cm of fresh snow on average this week (normal 17.8), then only 9 cm from 1 to 8 December (normal 21.9). Isola 2000 74 % above normal, Chamonix 6 %.

item.title: Will it snow in the next 3 weeks? Atlas, Alps, Pyrenees, US-Canada and Andes from ECMWF, NOAA and NASA (24 November 2026)
item.description: A science-based snow outlook to mid-December 2026 for five mountain ranges: the 50-member ECMWF ensemble for days 1-15, NOAA GEFS for days 16-21, NASA MODIS for the snow on the ground today. Chance of more snow than the 1991-2020 normal: Atlas 4 %, Alps 10 %, Pyrenees 46 %, US-Canada West 88 %, Andes 12 %.

item.title: Will it snow in the Atlas before mid-December? A 4 % chance of a normal fortnight (ECMWF, NOAA, NASA, 24 November 2026)
item.description: Snow outlook for the High and Middle Atlas, 24 November to 14 December 2026: 50 ECMWF ensemble members for 15 days, NOAA GEFS for days 16-21, NASA MODIS snow cover today. Only 4 % of members beat the 1991-2020 normal; Oukaïmeden median 0 cm, M'Goun 8.3 cm in the wettest tenth.

item.title: Mount baker ski area weather: tracking where the water is building up
item.description: Mt Baker sits at 28 cm on upper slopes, right where November typically sees snow at this height. Fresh powder is arriving this week, especially Thursday.

item.title: Italy's snow cover jumped 11,110 km² in seven days
item.description: Italy gained significant snow cover in a week, with the Aosta Valley receiving 176 cm in 72 hours. SnowScope shows 30,400 km² white on 24 November.

item.title: Rosa Khutor snow by month: 34 winters from 938 m to 2453 m
item.description: Rosa Khutor above Krasnaya Polyana: usual snow by month at the base, mid-mountain and top over 34 winters, the December gamble and the trend.

item.title: Finland vs Sweden ski snow: 46 winters at Levi, Ylläs, Åre, Hemavan
item.description: Finnish Lapland against the Swedish mountains: usual snow by month at eight resorts over 46 winters, who is losing snow and where it lies now.

item.title: Dolomites snow by month: Cortina, Val Gardena and Alta Badia compared
item.description: How snow depth changes month by month at three top Dolomites resorts across 46 past winters, from base to summit.

item.title: Telluride ski report: 51 in on the upper slopes (US West, 23 November)
item.description: Telluride has 51 in (130 cm) on upper slopes today. Brian Head Resort leads the US West with 57 in (144 cm), but Telluride's recent gains matter more for skiers planning the week ahead.

item.title: Switzerland: Glacier 3000 leads with 76 cm, well above normal for late November
item.description: Switzerland has 76 cm at Glacier 3000 on 23 November, more snow than in nine winters out of ten. The Bernese Oberland and Valais Alps received up to 144 cm in three days.

item.title: Where to find up to 29 cm of fresh snow in the next three days: Switzerland
item.description: 14 Swiss resorts tracked on 23 November; Zermatt leads with 63 cm depth, 29 cm more forecast by 26 November.

item.title: Bavaria and the Black Forest snow today: Zugspitze leads with 63 cm (23 November)
item.description: Zugspitze tops the region with 63 cm on 23 November. Nine resorts have snow; 34 cm fell in three days at Nebelhorn.

item.title: Prà Alpesina snow forecast: 57 cm expected by 26 November (Alps)
item.description: Prà Alpesina will see 57 cm of new snow by 26 November. Forecast data from 23 November shows heaviest falls on 25 November as freezing level rises.

item.title: La Pierre Saint-Martin snow forecast: up to 42 cm expected by 26 November (Pyrenees)
item.description: La Pierre Saint-Martin snow forecast: up to 42 cm expected by 26 November (Pyrenees). At Astun, the freezing level reaches 1,960 m to 3,170 m on 24 …

item.title: Alpe d'Huez Grand Domaine fresh snow report: 106 cm in 72 hours (Alps, 23 November)
item.description: Alpe d'Huez got 106 cm of fresh snow in 72 hours by 23 November. More powder coming, but watch for rain mid-week.
